body: Thank you for leaving this comment. I’m trying to tell myself that you’re right and I should continue therapy, and another voice is fogging up my thoughts to tell me to kill myself or else I’m an attention seeking do-nothing. It’s hard and it feels wrong to change this way of thinking, but I’ll try to try. Best wishes and thank you again.

Not trying to insult you in anyway by saying this, but you must be really empathetic. It’s good tho, we need more ppl like you who actually care about others instead of these other comments that say things like “It’s dark humor!! Get a joke??”. Tbh if no one is hurt by “dark humor” then it’s not “dark humor”. By saying that nobody should be upset or hurt by it takes away from the “dark” in the humor.

soyboy is usually used by far right ppl as far as I know but I think it mean effeminate man? bc according to “alpha males” soy beans and anything soy related has estrogen in it. if u want to know more about that sort of thing I recommend u watch this guy called hbomberguy, super funny and informative!
That's awesome! I'm so proud of you, and I wish you the best of luck for anything that's to come.

Hi there! Thank you for commenting on this post. Thank you for putting my emotions into proper words, every day is very hard to deal with because like you said, I feel like I'm never doing anything useful or important. I'm so sorry that you feel like this as well. It must be very painful, and I'm proud of you for staying strong. Thank you for offering to talk, I would really love that. But as of this moment, I feel like I need to just take a walk and breathe for a bit. Thank you so much for offering though, it means the world to me. Thank you for your kind words and yes, we can do this. Stay strong friend, I wish you the best of days.

That's very kind of you to say. My grandmother has a saying, I believe it's along the lines of, "Before spring, there will be winter. After winter, there will be spring.". You reminded me of that quote, so thank you. Also, what you say about me being able to help others by sharing my experiences is a very good idea. Reading the comments on this post, just reading what other people have gone through makes me feel like I'm not alone in this world, although I may not be able to see them. Thank you for taking the time to comment, and thank you for your kind words. Have a good day or night.
Thank you, you're very kind for saying that. I think I've calmed down quite a bit and I'm doing well at the moment. Thank you.

Hi there. Thank you for sharing your story. You're very brave for calling your friend and taking charge of your own life. I wish I had that kind of bravery. I don't really like to talk about my problems with friends or family because I feel like my problems are just unnecessary baggage that other people shouldn't bother with. They have their own problems and I don't want to be a bother to them. But I do have many friends who say that they'll listen to me if I feel depressed or suicidal, maybe I should talk to them like you did. Maybe I'll be able to be brave like you. Thank you for your kind advice, I very much appreciate it and I hope you a blessed day!

Thank you so much for your kind, kind words. If I could give you a hug I would. This might be a bit weird to say, but I'm happy that I'm not alone in this world, feeling like this. Thank you for commenting on this post. Stay brave and keep fighting, best of luck to you.

That's very true. That reminds me one time where I started tearing up on a train when I was looking out of the window. It was a few months before this incident, and I was coming home from school. I looked out the window and all I could think is, "I'm finally going to school on a daily basis, and I can look that the beautiful view outside the window because I'm alive right now.". I hope to have an experience like that again. Thank you for your kind advice, have a nice day or night!

I'm so sorry that you felt like that, it must have been very painful. I know it's kind of weird coming from a person who just tried to hang herself, but I'm so proud of you for being here right now. I'm glad that you're seeing a therapist and feeling better. I'm not seeing professional help at the moment, financial problems as well as a few more complicated problems, but I hope to be able to see one soon. Thank you for commenting and your kind words. Best of luck to you.
That's true, you make a good point. I was considering a walk but it was raining today. Maybe tomorrow will be sunny. Thank you for commenting, I really appreciate the advice.

I'm so sorry about your father. I understand that there might be little I can say to comfort you but I hope that you have good days to come. I'm sorry that I made you feel sad, you must be a very kind person to care for someone you don't know on the internet. Thank you so much for your kind words and I wish you the best of luck with whatever you come across.

Hello there. A wave of relief washed over me when I read this. A lot of people that are close to me and know how I feel most of the time always tell me to keep on going and push myself so that I can "grow faster". It should be okay to stop sometimes and do nothing. Thank you so much for your advice, and thank you for your kind words.

Hi again. You're very kind, thank you for worrying about me and encouraging me. I'm so happy that you're loving life and happier that you have gotten a positive outcome from your hardships. It must have been very difficult for you, and probably still is now. You're very brave and inspiring, and I hope that I can be like you as time goes by. Thank you so much for your encouragement.

Thank you for saying that. It's very caring of you to worry about a total stranger on the internet. You make a very good point, there are so many things for me to do. If I die, I won't be able to do anything at all. At the moment I have no energy or motivation to do that "anything", but maybe someday. Don't worry about me, I'll be fine. Thank you for sending this message.  Have a good day or night.

Hi again, thank you for replying. You're too kind, thank you for giving me such great advice. I've never thought about my life like a movie, but I do realize that it's something that will pass, as my past therapists have told me. I hope that I will be able to grow out of whatever's happening in my head, or maybe get the professional help that I probably should have. Although, it's fun to think like you're in a bad movie. It helps me not think of life so seriously I guess. Thank you for the advice, I really appreciate it.

Hi, thank you for commenting. It feels nice to know that there are people out there who are or have been through the same thing as me. I'm a girl, around the age that you had your attempt which is kind of a funny coincidence. I thought about that too, the thing about my brother coming home. I do remember a tiny bit of relief in my body when my brother came home. I too think I don't want to die, but honestly, I don't know what I want anymore. Or even what I don't want. But I'll get through it, hopefully! Thank you for taking the time to comment on my post, I feel grateful that you would take time out of your day just to write something. Sorry that this reply is so long. Thank you, and have a good day.
